name: Vagit Alekperov

controls.name: PJSC Lukoil
controls.role: Co-founder (1991) and largest individual shareholder; stepped down as president and left the board in April 2022 after UK sanctions

privateDeals.what: Lukoil signed a (non-exclusive) agreement to sell LUKOIL International GmbH (its international assets, excluding Kazakhstan operations) to Carlyle; requires OFAC approval; price not disclosed
Gunvor's ~$22B offer for Lukoil's international operations (Oct/Nov 2025) collapsed after US Treasury said it would not license the deal
Lukoil announced intention to divest international assets due to sanctions and began evaluating bidders

trophies.what: Coin collection; founded the International Numismatic Club in Moscow to display it
Formerly owned Dutch shipyard Heesen Yachts; transferred ownership to a Dutch foundation in 2022

policy.what: US OFAC designated Lukoil and Rosneft (plus 33 Russian subsidiaries) as blocked entities on Oct 22, 2025
Alekperov personally sanctioned by UK and Australia (April 2022), Canada (May 2022), New Zealand (Oct 2022)
Lukoil declared force majeure at Iraq's West Qurna-2 field (75% stake, ~480k bpd) on Nov 4, 2025 citing sanctions; Iraq halted payments
Lukoil's Bulgarian entities (incl. Burgas refinery) placed under an external/special administrator (Nov 2025)

giving.name: Foundation 'Our Future' (social entrepreneurship; founded 2007). Alekperov has said his Lukoil stake will pass to a charitable foundation under his will

watch.what: OFAC decision on licensing Lukoil International sale to Carlyle (or other buyers) and any extension/expiry of related general licenses
Fate of West Qurna-2 (Iraq) stake and Bulgarian Burgas refinery under special administration
Any change in US/UK sanctions on Lukoil or Alekperov in Russia-Ukraine negotiations
